settings.question: How much does wheel balancing cost in Calgary?
settings.answer: Wheel balancing at Prince Tires in SW Calgary is $20 per wheel, or $80 for all four — and the whole job takes about 20 minutes. That's the standalone rate for re-balancing tires already on your vehicle. If you're buying tires from us, balancing is included in the installation.

settings.question: What's the difference between balancing and alignment?
settings.answer: Balancing is about weight — making the tire and wheel spin evenly so there's no vibration. Alignment is about angles — how the wheels are aimed, which shows up as pulling to one side and uneven tread wear. They're separate jobs: Prince Tires handles balancing; we don't do alignments. If your symptom is a shake or buzz at speed, balancing is the fix you're looking for.

settings.question: How long does tire balancing take?
settings.answer: About 20 minutes for all four wheels. Book a time online and there's no waiting around — drop the vehicle at our SW Calgary shop, we balance the wheels, and you're back on the road the same day.

settings.question: How do I know my wheels need balancing?
settings.answer: The clearest sign is a vibration that shows up at highway speed — around 90 to 110 km/h — and smooths out when you slow down. You'll feel it in the steering wheel, the seat, or the floor. It often starts after a hard pothole hit, and Calgary's spring roads on 16th Ave or McKnight are good at knocking a wheel out of balance.

settings.question: Is balancing included with new tires?
settings.answer: Yes. Every tire we install at Prince Tires is balanced as part of the installation, so a new set starts off smooth. The $20-per-wheel rate is for re-balancing tires that are already mounted — usually after a pothole hit, or when a vibration shows up between seasons.

settings.question: How often should tires be balanced?
settings.answer: Tires are balanced every time they're mounted. After that, re-balance when you feel a vibration, after a hard pothole hit, or when you notice uneven wear. A lot of Calgary drivers have it checked at their seasonal tire change.

settings.question: Where can I get my tires balanced in Calgary?
settings.answer: Prince Tires at 111 42 Ave SW — just off Macleod Trail, a quick stop from most of the city. Wheel balancing is $20 per wheel, same-day appointments are usually available, and booking online takes under two minutes. Or call (403) 452-4283.

settings.heading: Tire Balancing Service in Calgary
settings.subheading: Steering wheel buzzing at highway speed? That's a wheel out of balance. Tire and wheel balancing at Prince Tires is $20 per wheel ($80 for all four) and takes about 20 minutes — same-day at our SW Calgary shop.
settings.pricing_intro: The wheel balance price at Prince Tires is simple: $20 per wheel, or $80 to balance all four — about 20 minutes for the full set. We spin each wheel-and-tire assembly on a computer balancer, find the heavy spots, and add small counterweights until it runs smooth. No more buzz in the steering wheel at 100 km/h on Deerfoot. Balancing is already included whenever we install a new set of tires; the $20-per-wheel rate is for re-balancing tires that are already on your vehicle.
